status: options — nothing built, nothing ships (AGENTS.md hard rule 9)

backdrop.question: Which composition for the open foredeck of the Fahrenheit on the approach to Bevelle?
backdrop.canon_notes: research §12.1/§12.3: open foredeck, metal deck plating lettered 'Salvage Dream CID', a guard rail then nothing (the drop is the frame edge), open sky/cloud, Bevelle growing on the horizon as the fight goes on.

options.A: RE-ROLLED once (hard rule: at most one re-roll per item). Both the first roll and the reroll came back OFF-CANON — a bird's-eye canyon-city shot with the ship as a tiny distant speck, not the foredeck the party stands on. Kept and flagged rather than re-rolled a second time, per the one-reroll cap.
options.B: Looking up at the ship's hull from the rail — closest to the research's 'over-the-shoulder from the deck' framing (§12.3 item 1), open sky, sense of motion.
options.C: Golden-hour side view with the rail in the foreground and the ship itself visible alongside — reads as 'we are on a deck, this is our ship,' but shows the whole hull from outside rather than standing on it.

backdrop.off_canon_seen: A is a clear miss both times — the model kept reading 'airship approach' as a flying city instead of the requested foredeck-with-rail composition. B and C are the usable pair; neither is a perfect match to the exact 'foredeck platform, party at the rail, Evrae's head filling the upper right, Bevelle's spires past its neck' shot in §12.3, since these are location-only backdrop renders (no humans, no boss composited in) — that composite would need to happen at the mockup/integration stage once a plate is picked.

boss_evrae.question: Which silhouette for Evrae, and should the chapter card use the NEAR or FAR read?
boss_evrae.canon_notes: research §12.2: a wyrm — sea-serpent built for the sky, must read as 'eel and dragon, never bat'; two silhouettes for one creature (NEAR = head-and-claws filling the upper third; FAR = long diagonal streak, small head, legible body); the throat needs a paintable charging state (Poison Breath's Inhale telegraph); cold/reptilian against a warm sky, one saturated accent reserved for the throat-charge and the eyes.

options.A: NEAR read: red/black scales, head and coils filling the frame, teal accent scales.
options.B: FAR read: cooler teal/gold palette, long diagonal coiled streak, more 'legible body' as the research asks for the chapter-card silhouette.
options.C: Throat-charge framing: warm orange throat glow against the same cold body, closest match to the 'paintable charging state' requirement.

boss_evrae.off_canon_seen: None disqualifying — silhouette reads as eel/dragon, not bat, in all three, and none show wings (correctly wingless). None yet show the scythe-limb forelimbs distinctly (they read as coiled body rather than bladed reaching limbs) — worth a note for whichever option is refined further.

no_cast_row: Per the brief: 'none for Evrae beyond the airship.' No supporting-cast render was queued for this chapter — Cid is invisible in the real encounter and the airship itself is the backdrop.
